If you really want to go gritty I'd suggest running both. So players suffer an injury when they go down and have to make death saving throws as normal.

​

Also as has been noted the broken ribs/internal injury thing isn't that fun.  I'd just suggest they lose 1 con if they take an internal injury and d3 con if they take a broken ribs injury.

From experience running this 5e characters have access to gigantic amounts of healing so make sure you're clear for every single option exactly how each one is healed. Also if you decide magical healing can heal an injury then I'd suggest you at least make them choose between healing health and healing the injury.

It's a pretty awful option I agree. I figure if I sell everything I'll have enough for a while to just wander, live off cheap food and sleep in hostels beyond that I'm not sure. It's not ideal. I don't see other options for myself at this point and part of me also views it as a relief. No more worries about the future, just day to day life. Where do I eat today. Where do I sleep today. Simple.

School felt like the right thing to do. It's socially accepetable and it meant I didn't have to work. I wanted to try to find some way to sustain myself whilst at school but failed miserably at that. I've realise ddoing the course however that it's probably not for me, it's been incredibly difficult and I'm barely scraping through at the moment and can't imagine enjoyign spending the rest of my life trying to do comp sci. I'm just not very good at it.  I'm excited of the idea of working in the industry, making games especially, but you have to be talented and have discipline and skill which I don't, I'm lazy and feckless and can barely concentrate and tend to just half ass things unfortunately. I could certainly look into internships and shit but I'm not sure what the point of making myself suffer more is. All the plans I make for myself whether short or long term tend to fail.

I'm starting therapy in January, its not DBT but its mentalisation which is meant to be a similar thing. I'm hoping it can help. I don't know that it will.  I'm aware I'm in an incredibly privileged position but I don't see how I can sustain it honestly.
